# Fallen Dragon Studios

> Wheel-thrown stoneware mugs, bowls, plates, planters with saucers and serving bowls, made in small kiln batches in Taos, New Mexico, USA. Sold finished from this site and shipped double-boxed inside the USA.

## What is sold (USD)
- Stoneware mug: $34
- Cereal bowl: $38
- Dinner plate: $46
- Planter with saucer (5, 6.5 or 8 in inside width): $58
- Serving bowl: $84
- Four-piece table set (dinner plate, side plate, cereal bowl, mug): $139

## Glazes
Rocket Pool (deep turquoise that runs and pools), celadon, tenmoku, chalk white. Every glaze costs the same.

## Pages
- /index.html : what the studio makes, prices, how an order runs, questions
- /mugs-and-bowls.html : mugs, bowls, plates and the table set: sizes, glazes, care
- /planters-and-serving.html : planters and the serving bowl: sizes, drainage, glazes
- /planter-pot-sizer.html : tool that sizes the next pot for a plant and works out the potting mix
- /about-the-studio.html : the studio, its week, what it will and will not do
- /shipping-and-packing.html : Original Delivery costs, times and packing
- /returns-and-breakage.html : 30-day returns, breakage, exchanges, refunds
- /order-stoneware.html : order request form with a running total

## Not offered
No pottery classes, no custom commissions, no wholesale, no shipping outside the USA.
